scenarios.upstream: prewalks at the first edit/write after the todo gate opens; bash and todo don't trigger
an edit before any todo call does not switch while a todo tool exists; the next edit after todo does
keeps the todo gate closed after a failed todo call
forces a continuation when the plan nudge gets a text-only reply, instead of silently ending the run
bounds a completed bash-only task to a single continuation instead of looping
does not switch on a read-only xd:// device dispatched through write (issue #7312)
scenarios.rationale: Stock Pi exposes no xd:// mutation-tier contract, so the extension cannot distinguish a read-only virtual-device write through its public API.

scenarios.upstream: switches on a write-tier xd:// device dispatched through write (issue #7312)
scenarios.rationale: Stock Pi exposes no xd:// mutation-tier contract, so the extension cannot distinguish a write-tier virtual-device write through its public API.

scenarios.upstream: re-arms continuation after tool progress between prose turns
skips the todo gate when todo is registered but not active (subagent-style restricted slates)
armPrewalk (the /prewalk slash command) pre-arms the switch for the very next edit/write
scenarios.rationale: Stock Pi's public extension API needs a run-scoped provider overlay instead of OMP's temporary session model switch.

scenarios.upstream: armPrewalk rejects a same-model same-effort no-op
scenarios.rationale: The extension resolves the no-op through its provider overlay and reports the safe unarmed outcome.

scenarios.upstream: /prewalk reports success only when the requested arm remains active
scenarios.rationale: The standalone command has no OMP arm-success return contract; it reports only actionable failures while the run owns its route.

scenarios.upstream: requires a fresh todo before a later explicit prewalk can hand off
effort-only prewalk on the same model downgrades the thinking level instead of silently skipping
scenarios.rationale: The temporary route is a provider overlay, so effort changes are applied at the overlay boundary rather than through OMP's session model switch.

scenarios.upstream: emits a notice when the prewalk target is a genuine no-op
scenarios.rationale: The extension keeps the session usable and leaves the planner selected when its resolved target is a no-op.

scenarios.upstream: treats a target effort the model clamps back to the active effort as a no-op
scenarios.rationale: Pi exposes the effective thinking level at the extension seam, so the extension compares the clamped target before installing its route.

scenarios.upstream: switches when a same-model target clears auto mode even though efforts both resolve to undefined
scenarios.rationale: Stock Pi exposes the current concrete thinking level but not OMP's configured auto-versus-fixed selector.

scenarios.upstream: leaves prewalk unarmed instead of crashing when the target has no configured auth
arms prewalk when the target resolves and has configured auth
scenarios.rationale: The standalone extension verifies and installs its provider overlay through the stock Pi public provider registry.

scenarios.upstream: does not implicitly re-arm configured prewalk while restoring a session
honors an explicit prewalk flag while restoring a session
scenarios.rationale: The standalone extension's explicit /prewalk auto command starts a run through its command adapter; restore remains a separate lifecycle boundary.
